title: Saurian Versus Mountain
description: Tlatem, from the Children of Echoes' tribal settlement, is presently troubled by a certain matter...

mainQuestExcel.title: Saurian Versus Mountain
mainQuestExcel.description: Tlatem, from the Children of Echoes' tribal settlement, is presently troubled by a certain matter...

dialogs.text: Come on, don't be discouraged. You just need to get well, and... keep trying! You'll make it to the mountaintop in no time!
Grooo... Groooo...
Are you hungry? Hmm... Then why don't I get you something to eat?
Hroo... Oroo...
What are you up to?
I'm playing with my buddy Qica. He's still small, but Mom says he'll be the equal of any other Yumkasaurus when he grows up!
Hroo... Rroooh...
Don't be sad. Your body's just too frail at the moment, and you were injured previously to boot.
Mom says you'll get better for sure. You've just gotta eat well and train with me.
Rooh? Rrrooh...
(Pet Qica.)
Grooo... Groooo...
Haha. Well, would you look at the time? We've got training coming up soon, so let's get eating!
Mom made these dried fruits, you know! Fried them in a big pot before adding lots of nice-smelling condiments...
Right, and she sprinkled in lots of sugar and petals, too... Either way, it tastes great! Just a moment, I'll give you some...
Wait. Where'd my dried fruits go? I'm sure I put them in my bag...
...Hroo, rrooo...
Whoa! Qica! Did you eat it all? C'mon, I've told you not to get greedy... You're gonna have trouble moving around if you eat too much!
...Rrooh, oroo...
Well, it's good to have an appetite.
Hroo, rroooh!
Is that so? In that case... I wanna be like Qica. I wanna eat lots, get bigger fast, and help Mom out.
Alright then, Qica! Let's get training!
Roar!
Let's see... How about we practice mountain climbing today?
R—Roar...
Oh come on, keep your chin up! We'll do it just like last time. It won't be too hard at all!
...Roar!
Right, Uncle Yawar told me last time that we'll have to find a reasonable "training goal" if we're gonna train right...
Now, if only I could find a proper adventurer, and get them to help set some targets...
I'm pretty decent as adventurers go...
Really? Uh, then... Would you mind helping me?
Need me to take you mountain climbing?
No no, wait. If you're that good, there's no way we'll be able to keep up with you.
So what we'll do is time you while you climb.
Alright then. Climb that mountain as fast as you can. We're counting on you!
Rawr! Rrooh!
Alright then. Follow me, let's get started!
Proper adventurer, you say? Look no further.
He who eats more grows more.
How did he get hurt?
I don't know... but maybe Mom does! Qica was already ill when she brought him in.
He couldn't eat and didn't even have the strength to move. All I could do was dissolve some medicine in water and have him drink it every day.
He recovered in the end, but... his body is still really weak, so he can't scamper all over the cliffsides like the other Yumkasaurs.
That's really upsetting for him, so I'm trying to help him get back into tip-top shape... stronger than any other Yumkasaurus!
Roar!
Good boy, good boy! Eaten your fill today? Ready to train?
Raar, oroo, rrooh!
Pretty energetic today, aren't we? Awesome! Let's do this!
Yeah, let's do this!
Huh? Oh, hello there! We're doing some more mountain climbing training right now.
Rroo! Wrroo!
Wrooo, rrooh...
How's the training coming along?
Well... we're "making progress." Qica's made it up a lot further this time.
It's just that Qica's not very familiar with how you climb mountains, and...
Could you demonstrate for us again, by the way?
Sure I can.
Thank you so much! I'm sure I'll be able to catch your movements this time.
You keep your eyes peeled too, alright, Qica?
Roar!
We're counting on you!
So what we'll do is time you while you climb.
Hrroo, roooh...
Watch closely this time, alright?
Of course! Qica and I won't miss a thing this time!
Looks like he's recovering nicely.
That's right. Mom says I'm getting real good at caring for him.
Qica's improved loads. He can climb way higher than he could last time.
It's just that Qica's not very familiar with how you climb mountains, and...
Hehe. We're in your capable hands, then! We'll be watching your movements carefully and timing you from down below.

flow.stepDescription: Climb to the top of the mountain

dialogs.text: Hehe. We're in your capable hands, then! We'll be keeping time for you from here.
Rawr, Rrooh? Hrroo...
Mountain, so high, so tired...
You're amazing! You're just about as fast as Mayta!
H—Heh, it didn't quite go as well as I'd hoped...
Really? You mean you could've been faster still? Wow. Guess you really are an expert adventurer, huh...
If we set this time as our goal... Hmm...
Hrroo, roooh...
...Yeah, I know, it's going to be a bit difficult for you, huh?
Guess I'll go show Mayta your climbing time. Maybe he can come up with a more... reasonable training plan for us?
Anyway, thanks a lot for your help. Here, have this Cacahuatl!
We picked it ourselves, so it's super fresh, and it'll make super tasty chocolate!
Orrooo, orrooo!
In that case, we'll head out now. I wonder if Mayta's back at the settlement. He hasn't gone out climbing again, has he...
Who's Mayta?
He's a friend of mine who's real good at mountain climbing. Apart from Big Sis Roca, almost no one's his match.
Wow, you're awesome! I couldn't catch what you were doing at all — you've got to be even faster than Mayta, I bet!
I did alright, I think.
I don't think Qica will be able to match your time, though... It's way too fast...

questNarration.text: You come down the mountain and return to Tlatem...
